name: TalkMoves
summary: 567 transcripts of K-12 math lessons, annotated sentence by sentence for ten teacher and student talk moves.
cite: Suresh, A., Jacobs, J., Harty, C., Perkoff, M., Martin, J. H., & Sumner, T. (2022). The TalkMoves Dataset: K-12 Mathematics Lesson Transcripts Annotated for Teacher and Student Discursive Moves. LREC 2022. https://aclanthology.org/2022.lrec-1.497

fits.how: Its labels could check a detector that marks talk moves in tutoring turns for the teacher, against people's labels.

connect.note: Comes down as its repository's archive. It could check a detector against people's labels, but the harness has no talk-move detector to check yet. Non-commercial and share-alike: asks you to accept its license first.
